headline: Why OLPC’s $100 laptop never stood a chance
summary: The One Laptop Per Child (OLPC) initiative aimed to provide affordable computers to children globally. Despite inspiring goals, the $100 XO-1 laptop project ultimately failed. The article explores the reasons behind the ambitious initiative's downfall.

headline: Googlebooks might be the real deal
summary: The author traveled to San Francisco to experience Googlebooks. This article is part of "Installer No. 145", a guide to tech and Verge-related news. It hints at significant developments regarding Googlebooks and other tech.

headline: The smart home graveyard is getting crowded
summary: Many smart home devices and services are failing, creating a "graveyard" of defunct products. The article analyzes the fragile state and challenges faced by connected devices. It reflects on the unfulfilled promise of smart home technology a decade ago.

headline: Apple hit with $5.7 billion in damages over haptic patents
summary: A federal jury awarded Taction $5.7 billion in damages against Apple. The lawsuit centered on Apple infringing two haptic technology patents owned by Taction. The patents involve vibration-based tactile transducer technology used in Apple devices.

headline: Corsair Gaming Headsets See Early Prime Big Deal Days Discounts on Amazon UK
summary: Amazon UK is offering early discounts on Corsair gaming headsets. Deals are available ahead of the official Prime Big Deal Days event. Models include wireless VOID v2 and wired HS65 SURROUND headsets.

headline: Star Wars Nabs Spider-Man Director Jon Watts for First Movie in Disney's New Skywalker Saga Trilogy
summary: Jon Watts, director of Spider-Man, is reportedly set to direct a new Star Wars movie. This film will be the first in Disney's new Skywalker Saga trilogy. The move signals Disney's plan for the next chapter of the Star Wars universe.

headline: Godzilla Minus Zero Review
summary: "Godzilla Minus Zero" delivers strongly on its kaiju action. The review notes a lack of the same emotional depth found in its predecessor. Despite this, the film is recommended for its monster spectacle.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Metroid Prime 4, Nintendo Switch 2, and More
summary: This article compiles a list of the best current deals on gaming products. Featured items include "Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave" and "Metroid Prime 4". It also mentions news or deals related to the potential Nintendo Switch 2.

headline: Burnham proposes NHS-style social care system for England
summary: A proposal has been made for an NHS-style social care system in England. The prime minister compared England's current social care to "American healthcare" in terms of unfairness. The plan aims to reform and improve the country's social care provisions.

headline: Orange Order march row goes to heart of ongoing divisions in Northern Ireland
summary: A dispute over a controversial Orange Order parade highlights deep-seated divisions. The incident serves as a reminder that Northern Ireland's peace process is ongoing. It underscores persistent tensions and unresolved issues in the region.

headline: Ten NHS staff removed over Noah Woods data breach
summary: Ten NHS staff members have been removed following a data breach involving Noah Woods. East Suffolk and North Essex NHS Foundation Trust launched an "urgent" investigation. The incident raises concerns about patient data security within the NHS.

headline: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
summary: South Africa experienced two mass shootings hours apart, resulting in 27 fatalities. The country is grappling with high levels of gang-related armed violence. These incidents highlight the ongoing struggle to curb violent crime.
